title: Path mutation validation fails open when reparse-point inspection raises OSError
observed_behavior: _path_is_reparse catches every OSError from symlink/reparse inspection and returns False. path_boundary_check then reports ok=true, reason_code=OK, and 'no reparse components'; ensure_path_boundary_safe_for_mutation therefore permits the target. An isolated current-HEAD probe on an existing nested file with os.lstat forced to raise OSError returned exactly that successful result.
expected_invariant: A mutation boundary that cannot determine whether an existing path component is a symlink, junction, or reparse point must fail closed with an actionable inspection-error reason; inability to inspect must never be represented as proof that no reparse component exists.
root_cause: The boolean helper collapses the distinct states 'not a reparse point' and 'inspection failed' into False, so its caller has no way to preserve uncertainty or stop mutation.
failure_scenario: A local filesystem, transient access condition, or damaged path component causes lstat to fail while containment and existence checks still succeed. A cleanup, repair, rename, or other backend mutation guarded by ensure_path_boundary_safe_for_mutation proceeds through a path whose reparse status was never established, defeating the guard's stated mutation-safety evidence.
evidence: layout.py lines 63-72 converts OSError to False; lines 124-134 converts all-False inspection results to OK.
layout.py lines 137-151 raises only when result.ok is false, so the inspection failure reaches mutation callers as success.
Isolated temporary-tree probe patched mediapipeline.core.paths.layout.os.lstat to raise OSError and received {ok:true, reason_code:'OK', reason:'path is within root and has no reparse components'}.
The 74-test focused path/queue/rerun set passes; test_service_path_layout covers containment, missing leaves, symlinks, and Windows junctions but not inspection errors.
affected_flows: failure cleanup and repair/reconcile apply paths
rename, retention, and other callers that rely on ensure_path_boundary_safe_for_mutation
existing_safeguards: Lexical containment, cross-volume rejection, root-target rejection, root/path existence checks, explicit symlink/junction detection when inspection succeeds, and backend ownership of mutation are present.
safeguard_gap: The strongest component-level check silently becomes affirmative safety evidence when its operating-system inspection fails.
tests_missing: Existing component whose lstat/reparse inspection raises OSError is rejected
Inspection failure returns a distinct non-OK reason code
Mutation wrapper raises rather than proceeding when reparse status is unknown
recommended_remediation: Return a tri-state or PathBoundaryCheck-style inspection result from the component helper; propagate OSError as a distinct REPARSE_INSPECTION_FAILED non-OK boundary result with the affected component and safe operator guidance. Add injected-OSError tests for root, intermediate, and leaf components.
remediation_risk: low to medium: fail-closed behavior can temporarily block a mutation on inaccessible paths, which is the intended conservative outcome and should include actionable diagnostics
validation_rung: Focused path-layout and every mutation-caller unit test, injected root/intermediate/leaf OSError probes, Windows junction coverage, and strict change-packet validation; representative real media is not required.
prior_audit_relationship: New exact-current operational reliability finding; no current path-local finding for layout.py was present in the repository-audit fragments.

title: One unstatable rerun enrollment suppresses every valid enrollment candidate
observed_behavior: The function sorts all enrollment JSON paths with item.stat().st_mtime inside one try block and returns an empty list on any OSError. In a current-HEAD temporary-tree probe containing valid good.json and bad.json records, forcing Path.stat to fail only for bad.json produced candidate_count=0 and hid good.json as well.
expected_invariant: A single disappearing or unreadable enrollment must be isolated and reported without erasing discoverable evidence for every other enrollment, especially during startup reconciliation and duplicate-recovery lookup.
root_cause: Per-file metadata access is performed inside a collection-wide sort expression guarded by one aggregate exception handler; the handler converts partial enumeration failure into an indistinguishable empty directory result.
failure_scenario: One stale enrollment is concurrently removed, has a transient metadata error, or becomes inaccessible. Startup reconciliation checks zero reruns, recovery lookup fails to find existing durable enrollments, and recovery/manifest flows can act as though no enrollment exists even though valid records remain on disk.
evidence: evidence.py lines 227-230 wraps the complete sort in one OSError handler and returns [].
rerun_lifecycle.py lines 403-414 uses the candidate list for recovery-key lookup and lines 825-865 use it for startup reconciliation.
rerun_control.py lines 179-250 uses the list to discover existing recovery generations/logical enrollments, and lines 1220-1244 use it when validating v2 manifest enrollment evidence.
Isolated two-file probe with one selective Path.stat OSError returned zero candidates instead of retaining good.json.
The focused 74-test path/queue/rerun set passes; no test injects a metadata failure among otherwise valid enrollment files.
affected_flows: duplicate/recovery enrollment lookup and generation allocation
existing_safeguards: Enrollment JSON reads are individually tolerant, callers use transition locks, startup reconciliation never replays media, and durable manifest correlation exists when candidates are returned.
safeguard_gap: Per-record read tolerance occurs only after the aggregate stat/sort step, so one metadata error prevents every valid record from reaching those safeguards and produces no diagnostic evidence.
tests_missing: One unstatable enrollment does not hide valid siblings
Skipped enrollment metadata errors are surfaced in reconciliation evidence
Concurrent disappearance during candidate ordering preserves the remaining records
recommended_remediation: Enumerate candidates, stat each path independently with per-path error capture, retain sortable records that succeed, and expose skipped/error evidence to reconciliation callers. Use a deterministic fallback ordering for files whose time cannot be read only if their content can still be safely identified.
remediation_risk: low: the change is read-only evidence enumeration, but ordering and limit behavior should be tested under concurrent file churn
validation_rung: Focused rerun lifecycle/control tests, concurrent-disappearance and selective-stat-failure probes, startup reconciliation integration coverage, and strict change-packet validation; representative real media is not required.
prior_audit_relationship: New exact-current operational reliability finding; no current path-local finding for rerun/evidence.py was present in the repository-audit fragments.
